entities.summary: Jan Hatzius is the chief economist of investment bank Goldman Sachs. Notable for his bearish forecasts prior to the 2008 financial crisis, he is a three-time winner of the Lawrence R. Klein Award for the most accurate US economic forecast over the prior four years. He has also won a number of other forecasting awards, including the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, and Institutional Investor annual forecaster rankings.
